decisions.statement: A code is signed with EdDSA over an Ed25519 key.
A code names one audience, and an audience of two is no audience.
A code whose life runs past sixty seconds is refused however well it is signed.
No clock tolerance is allowed, so an expired code is expired.
A code that will not read is nobody rather than an error.
A code carries the hash of a secret its holder keeps, and never that secret.
A code carrying that hash reads only where the secret shown hashes to it.
A code carrying no such hash reads only where no secret is shown.
One reader answers every code, and the hash is weighed where the signature is.

definition: the short-lived signed code alanwalton.com mints and a peripheral reads
